assay: bulk poly-A RNA-seq (Illumina Stranded mRNA), NextSeq 2000 PE100; Salmon 1.10.2 -> tximport gene level (S4.5.p1, S4.6.p1)
sample_inclusion: male Wistar rats, 2x2 between-animal design: saline/monocrotaline (CC) x sedentary/4-week aerobic treadmill training (S4.1.p1, S4.2.p1)
RNA-seq on left medial gastrocnemius of six animals per group -> 24 libraries (S4.5.p1)
sample_exclusion: which 6 of 9-12 animals per group were sequenced is not reported (S4.5.p1)
primary_estimand: Cardiac-cachexia (monocrotaline) effect on the gastrocnemius transcriptome within sedentary (CC-Sed vs Sed) and within trained (CC-Ex vs Ex) rats; the paper infers that aerobic training attenuates the CC signature by comparing the two (S2.2.p1-p2, ABS). The training effect itself (Ex vs Sed, CC-Ex vs CC-Sed) and the disease x training interaction were not tested in the paper.

blocking_or_covariance.note: one muscle sample per animal, independent groups

matrix_scale: Salmon/tximport gene-level counts, deposited as integer 'Raw counts of Salmon mapped reads' (GEO)
paper_method: DESeq2 v1.44.0 (S4.6.p2); model/fit structure (one 4-group fit vs pairwise) not reported

paper_threshold.effect_cutoff_original: log2 fold-change magnitude of 1 or greater (|log2FC| >= 1)
paper_threshold.note: 'BH corrected, Wilcoxon p-test' in S4.6.p2; DESeq2 uses a Wald test, the Wilcoxon wording is unexplained

reported_counts.top_genes: CC-Sed up Tnnc1, Tpm3, Tnni1, Myl3, Nr4a3; CC-Ex up Hbb, Hba-a1, Hba-a3, Aqp4, Prodh; CC-Ex down Nrip3, Egr1 (S2.2.p3)

enrichment.method: clusterProfiler GO and KEGG ORA on DEGs, padj<0.05 BH (S4.6.p2)
